overview: TradeNest Naturals manufactures spray dried Alphonso mango powder for commercial formulations. Derived from ripe Indian Alphonso mangoes, the product preserves natural color and distinct aromatic notes through controlled spray drying. The fine powder delivers high solubility and consistent dispersion across diverse processing lines. As an FSSAI-licensed manufacturer and IEC-registered exporter, we maintain rigorous processing standards for industrial supply.

Our facility operates a structured six-step manufacturing process from raw fruit sourcing through to final dispatch. With low moisture content and uniform mesh sizing, this powder integrates smoothly into automated dosing systems. We offer custom packaging, private label solutions, and export documentation support. We provide bulk quantities starting from five kilograms to support brand owners, manufacturers, and distributors worldwide.
highlights: Processed using advanced spray drying technology
Uniform particle size of 80 to 100 mesh
Superior solubility in water and liquid bases
Preserves natural color and characteristic aroma
applications: Instant beverage mixes and fruit juices
Ice creams, yogurts, and dairy formulations
Bakery items including cakes and muffins

faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity for this product?
faqs.a: The minimum order quantity is 5 kg, accommodating both pilot product development and large commercial runs.

faqs.q: What packaging formats are available for bulk orders?
faqs.a: We supply 25 kg bags, 25 kg HDPE containers, 5 to 10 kg bags, and custom private-label pouches or jars.

faqs.q: Do you provide custom mesh sizes and OEM services?
faqs.a: Yes. We offer OEM manufacturing, private labeling, and custom mesh sizes upon request to match your technical requirements.

faqs.q: How does TradeNest Naturals support international buyers?
faqs.a: As an IEC-registered exporter, we offer export documentation support and prepare robust bulk packaging suitable for international logistics.

faqs.q: Can buyers request product samples prior to placing orders?
faqs.a: Yes. Product samples are available on request to assist your technical evaluation and formulation trials.

faqs.q: What is the recommended storage condition and shelf life?
faqs.a: The shelf life is 12 to 24 months when stored in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight and moisture.
